budget_items.topic: Pump stations and capital needs spending
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula said the Commission would spend a figure on pump stations and capital needs, revised downward and to be covered by transfers from other line items.
budget_items.quote: paula stated they will be spending $106k on pump stations and capital needs. the revised figure was $95k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY25 capital costs rose to a printed figure, driven by Dana St. repairs over $100K, leaving a small emergency buffer.
budget_items.quote: the capital costs for fy25 has gone up to $335k, due to the repairs at dana st. being over $100k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula stated the Retained Earnings balance is about a printed figure.
budget_items.quote: she stated the retained earnings balance is now about $1.7mil.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula proposed moving printed amounts from Retained Earnings to Capital and to the Operating budget, leaving a printed balance.
budget_items.quote: she is proposing moving $35k to capital and $381k into the operating budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY25 Capital Expense line item is stated to be a printed figure.
budget_items.quote: the fy25 capital expense line item will be $350k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: John noted the Commission voted at the last meeting to move a printed amount, and discussed whether to move more.
budget_items.quote: john stated that they voted to move $250k at the last meeting and the commission discussed whether to move more.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave suggested explaining a printed rate increase at the start of the budget presentation.
budget_items.quote: dave suggested explaining the $12.34 rate increase up front.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY25 invitation for bids would be funded from a printed ARPA amount.
budget_items.quote: this will be done with the $100k arpa funding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Money for pumps is said to be available under the Green Communities grant; the application was not yet out. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the application is not available yet but money is available for pumps so she is working with matt (wright pierce) to get the data together for the application.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State revolving funds were considered for repairs but judged too slow (1 to 2 years) to use for current repairs. No figure printed.
budget_items.quote: they discussed obtaining state revolving funds but found that it is 1 to 2 years to get them, if you qualify, so it is not an option for repairs they need to do now.
